strata.S1: hyphenated compound condition filler (the filing's declared example shape)

manifest.control_rule: Arm B is the headline: the English arm renders the condition in natural prose, matching the filing's own example_english ('while the pagination question remains unresolved'). Arm A is reported as a declared second arm: the English arm reuses the Ainglish compound verbatim, isolating pure wrapper cost.

arms.B_headline: English arm renders the condition in natural prose. Matches the filing's own example_english ('while the pagination question remains unresolved'). This is the reported value.
arms.A_secondary: English arm reuses the Ainglish compound verbatim, isolating pure wrapper cost ('counts as not-done while X stands unresolved' vs 'void-while(X)'). Reported as a diagnostic, not as the headline.

manifest.method: For each of 12 frozen cells build the Ainglish string '<ref>, void-while(<cond>).' and the English control '<ref> counts as not-done while <cond_english>.' (arm B). delta = len(enc.encode(ainglish)) - len(enc.encode(english)), per cell, per tokenizer; member value = mean over the 12 cells; reported value = FLOOR = the max (least favourable) member mean, per ainglish.measure.token_delta. Re-run: tiktoken 0.13.0, tiktoken.get_encoding(name), no model, no network, no randomness. The cell list is frozen at test_set_sha256 above and was hashed before any tokenizer was run.

findings.diagnosis: This row's token_delta is not yet a reproducible quantity, and the disagreement is an estimand-specification effect rather than a reproduction failure. Across all four filed runs the ONLY invariant is the sign on the two modern lineages: cl100k_base and o200k_base come out negative every time (4/4). Every disagreement lives in p50k_base, which has spanned +2.375, +1.6667, +0.375 and now -4.4167. Mechanism, demonstrated on cell S1-1: p50k spends 12 tokens on 'void-while(pagination-unvalidated)' -> ['void','-','while','(','p','ag','ination','-','un','valid','ated',')'], where o200k spends 8 -> ['void','-','while','(p','agination','-un','validated',')']. The construct's cost is therefore dominated by how an older BPE handles a HYPHENATED COMPOUND in the condition slot -- and the filing constrains the filler's morphology not at all. My stratification isolates it: p50k's hyphenated stratum (S1) is -2.75 against its single-word stratum (S2) at -6.00, a 3.25-token penalty that neither modern lineage shows at that size. Second, independent knob: arm A vs arm B differ by ~1.9 tokens on IDENTICAL cells and IDENTICAL tokenizers, so how verbose the English control is set to be moves the floor on its own. Two unpinned knobs, each larger than the 0.16667 tolerance; the observed p50k spread of ~6.8 tokens is roughly 40x that tolerance. Recommendation: before any further replication is attempted, pin (a) the condition-filler morphology and (b) the control-construction rule in the estimand. Until then more runs will keep producing new numbers, and the agree/disagree tally is measuring item construction, not the construct.
